doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Modification of Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 通期連結業績予想の修正ならびに剰余金の配当（中間配当）および期末配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 連結配当性向30～40%を目指すとの基本方針のもと、通期連結業績予想の上方修正および足元の財務状況を総合的に勘案

summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 45 yen per share from 40 yen, and year-end dividend raised to 45 yen from 40 yen, for total of 90 yen (previous guidance: 80 yen). Full-year net profit forecast increased 20.0% to 12.0 billion yen on strong overseas subsidiary performance and cost management.
summary_jp: 中間配当を40円から45円に、期末配当を40円から45円に引き上げ、通期合計90円に。海外子会社業績の好調と原価管理の徹底で、通期当期純利益予想を20.0%上方修正し12,000百万円へ。
